literal_meaning: দলের বল বা শক্তি (group's strength or force)
figurative_meaning_en: followers, supporters, or one's own allies
example_sentences_in_bangla: নেতা তার দলবল নিয়ে সভায় উপস্থিত হলেন।
সে দলবল ছাড়া কোনো সিদ্ধান্ত নেয় না।
example_sentences_in_english: The leader arrived at the meeting with his entourage.
He doesn't make any decisions without his posse.
note: Refers to collective support in social or political contexts, common in Bengali colloquial usage.
